source.title: Shinners & Mahler's Illustrated Flora of North Central Texas
source.authors: Diggs, G. M. Jr.; Lipscomb, B. L.; O'Kennon, R. J.
source.original_treatment_name: Vitis cinerea (Engelm.) Millardet, including varieties cinerea and helleri

species_general.leaves: Leaf tips or lobes acute; basal sinus variable
species_general.fruit: Purplish-black berries 4–9 mm with slight bloom

historical_var_cinerea.leaves: Usually over 10 cm; lower surface soft, cobwebby/woolly or densely pale-hairy

source_scope_note: Historical varieties and synonyms preserved by original names; measurements never automatically transferred to different modern taxon concepts.
unresolved_taxonomy_or_source_notes: Historic source's broad V. cinerea includes var. helleri, now represented in separate V. berlandieri record
Var. cinerea traits documented separately to prevent incorrect modern species-wide claims
preservation: Additive source record; existing gallery, pictures, credits and species files unchanged
